mentions.name: Custom Book Dust Jacket Creator
mentions.description: A universal tool for creating and printing custom dust jackets for books. Users enter book information such as title, author, size, and summary, choose a design/layout, and can then print the jacket themselves for free (with a large enough printer) or have it printed by a professional.
mentions.problem: Collectors struggle to get a visually consistent book collection because editions and cover/spine designs change constantly, especially across long series, and it is even harder to match styles when buying rare or old second-hand books online.
mentions.audience: Book collectors who want consistent cover designs across book series or for rare and old second-hand books.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a universal tool to create and print custom dust jackets.
